prop has_universal_self_equality(x R):
    forall y R:
        x = x

have universally_self_equal_reals set = {x R: $has_universal_self_equality(x)}

witness exist x R st {$has_universal_self_equality(x)} from 0:
    by def $has_universal_self_equality(0)

have I set
have S nonempty_set
have g fn(alpha I) S

general_cart(I, S, g) = {f fn(alpha I)big_union(S): $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)}

claim:
    ? forall f fn(alpha I)big_union(S):
        forall alpha I:
            f(alpha) $in g(alpha)
        =>:
            $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
    forall alpha I:
        f(alpha) $in g(alpha)
    $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)

claim:
    ? forall f fn(alpha I)big_union(S):
        $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
        =>:
            forall alpha I:
                f(alpha) $in g(alpha)
    $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
    forall alpha I:
        f(alpha) $in g(alpha)

claim:
    ? forall f fn(alpha I)big_union(S):
        $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
        =>:
            f $in general_cart(I, S, g)
    $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
    f $in general_cart(I, S, g)
